message.content: Determining the “best” soccer player at any given moment is inherently subjective and depends on criteria such as current form, influence on games, statistics, or personal preference. As of now (late 2026), many pundits and fans still consider Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo among the top performers, but emerging talents like Erling Haaland, Kylian Mbappé, and Kevin De Bruyne also frequently appear in discussions about the best players in the world. Ultimately, the title of “best” varies depending on who you ask and what aspects of play you value most.
message.reasoning: The user asks "What is the best player in soccer today?" This is a subjective question. We can provide an answer with some context. There's no tool needed. Just respond.
